reason: After reviewing the complete 10-K filing for Digi International Inc. (DGII) for fiscal year ended September 30, 2025, no Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures were disclosed by the company. The filing contains extensive business descriptions, segment information, and strategic commentary about IoT markets, but does not provide any specific TAM valuations or market size estimates that the company itself has disclosed. The company describes its products and services across IoT Products & Services and IoT Solutions segments, discusses industry growth trends qualitatively (e.g., 'multi-year expansion', 'digital transformation'), but does not quantify any total addressable market opportunities.
